body:
@sander-su, sounds good to me. There's just one thing to consider in terms of backwards-compat: any of the properties now promoted to runtime-configurable should be obtained from the old location as a fallback. I.e. first try quarkus.kafka-streams.xyz, then kafka-streams.xyz.

Would you be interested in creating a PR for this?
@gunnarmorling I can make a PR but as this is a side R&D project I dont know when it will be ready ..
Hey @sander-su, did you have a chance yet to take a look at this? No worries if not, just to see where we are.
No not yet, also no idea when I have time.

@sander-su @gunnarmorling any idea where do I find these keys as constants?
sasl.jaas.config, ssl.truststore.location, ...

The thing is that it is not a finite list. 
If you use for instance the confluent schema registry you'd need schema.registry.url.
Depending on your kafka installation you might need some other auth plugin. Some implementation of oauthbearer with config for instance.

Hence I proposed to let it up to the user what is build time and what is runtime config.

Thanks for taking a shot at this but to have a generic solution for this it needs to be more flexible.

> The thing is that it is not a finite list.

Yeah, well aware of it.

But I had a long discussion yday: https://quarkusio.zulipchat.com/#narrow/stream/187030-users/topic/build-time.20vs.20runtime.20properties.3F
Where as you can see the proposal is to do it like they did it for k8s support -- just keep on adding properties, as that's the only way you're adding value ...

I do still have back-compatibility, where I try to load from anywhere ...
* https://github.com/alesj/quarkus/tree/kafka_sasl

Which I guess will solve this runtime thing ... but not add much tooling value to it.

My question was just to find those constants, if they exist.
The rest is as it is -- just adding new props when needed ...

> 
> Which I guess will solve this runtime thing ... but not add much tooling value to it.
> 
Agree, can you have both? 
So a static set for the tools and just load it all at runtime?

> My question was just to find those constants, if they exist.
> The rest is as it is -- just adding new props when needed ...

config is here
https://github.com/apache/kafka/tree/trunk/clients/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/common/config

Hi all. Thank you for your work on this! If I understand correctly, this is going to add support for all the currently missing Kafka Streams configuration properties, and not just SASL?

If desired, I can help with testing these changes.
What is the status on this? Can I help in any way to move this forward - for example by testing?
